meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 它会把你 claude-mem 里的历史观测记录筛选、汇总成一个专题语料库,加载进 AI 会话后,你可以用对话向它提问,它只依据这份语料作答,并保留追问的上下文。
howto.when: 当你想从历史观测记录里整理出某个主题的「脑」、想询问过去的工作模式,或想就某个话题汇总经验时,它会接管。

say.text: 把 hooks-expertise 加载起来,然后我问你 hooks 的生命周期
say.note: 加载语料并开启一个可追问的 AI 会话

say.text: 列出我所有的语料库,看看各自的状态
say.note: 会显示语料库列表、统计和加载状态

howto.what_en: It compiles your claude-mem observations into a focused, named corpus, loads it into an AI session, and answers your questions from that corpus while keeping follow-up context.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want to build a focused "brain" from your observation history, ask about past work patterns, or compile expertise on a specific topic.

say_en.text: Build a knowledge base named hooks-expertise with only hook-related records
say_en.note: Filters observations to create the corpus

say_en.text: Prime hooks-expertise, then I'll ask you about the hooks lifecycle
say_en.note: Loads the corpus and opens a follow-up session

say_en.text: List all my corpora and their priming status
say_en.note: Shows corpora with stats and status
